name: zvid_update_cached_client_rect_if_update_mask_enabled
description: zVid::UpdateCachedClientRectIfUpdateMaskEnabled refreshes the cached client rect only when the renderer-path update mask query is nonzero.
known_limits: The local VC5 byte target zvid_update_cached_client_rect_if_update_mask_enabled covers 0x443a40 from its current CZGameFrame.cpp compile host; this manifest records the behavior smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x443a40 validates QueryCachedClientRectUpdateMaskIf3dfx() followed by a tail call to zVideo::UpdateCachedClientRectScreenCoords only when the query is nonzero.
The native smoke verifies the cached rect remains unchanged when the update mask is zero and is refreshed to the window client dimensions when the mask is nonzero.
